newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Bucharest bourse trading mixed, turnover inches up.
newsitem.headline: Bucharest bourse trading mixed, turnover inches up.

text.p: Bucharest share prices drifted sideways on Tuesday amid thin investor interest and attempts by market participants to sell while prices are still attractive.
"Demand will remain light throughout the week and trading unimpressive. I think the holiday mood is to blame for the situation," said one trader.

Three independent market indices, the VAB, the BIG and the CAS-SE, based on average prices and market capitalisation, inched up 1.1, 0.95 and 1.11 percent respectively from Monday, mainly due to rises in blue chips.
A bourse report at the end of the day showed the average prices of 21 stocks picked up, while 21 fell and seven remained flat. Four companies had no trade and one was suspended.
Volume was slightly up at 2.1 million shares on turnover of 8.8 billion lei - some 780 million lei up from Monday.
"The top tier, with an overall turnover level of 7.8 billion lei, dominated the session, while the second tier was sluggish," a broker said.

On the first tier, Arctic ACTB.BX refrigerator maker was the most active, trading some 490,000 shares, followed by Oltchim chemical plant, with a volume of around 400,000. Arctic closed flat at 3,500 lei and Oltchim firmed 50 lei to 3,850.
Traders said foreign investors, not very active in the market in the holiday season, had focused mostly on high-cap Terapia pharmaceuticals on Tuesday.
"Terapia promises H1 results above expectations," said a trader. "Along with the other pharmaceuticals Antibiotice, it still carries a broker 'buy' tag."
Terapia closed at 11,200 lei, 1,000 up on the previous
close and 1,200 firmer than the opening.
